title: Concert song, audio and visual-source catalog
scope: Reference index and proposals. No lyrics, audio, video or raw private documents are embedded.
evidence_policy: Metadata access proves file identity and availability to the connector, not a completed download or valid decoded audio.
Reported durations, digests and film checks are attributed to prior builders; they are not independent verification by this audit.
All11 selected full sources were independently hashed, probed and completely decoded without FFmpeg errors. The11 repository promo clips were probed;02 and10 decode to complete silence.
A source ID or hash must never be guessed. Preserve null when unresolved and verify full bytes before analysis or final rendering.
A newer source record supersedes an older missing-source note without deleting that historical note.
All live arrangement mappings remain estimates until rehearsal or an explicit performance timing decision confirms them.
Historical full-song deliveries and code-ahead fixes must be treated separately. Proposed enhancements are not blanket approval.
This catalog contains no authorization to retime music, alter lyrics, spend money, or start all full-song renders.
